data.one_liner: A widget to play and control image sequence animations repeatedly or manually.
data.what_it_does: tween_image_widget provides a Flutter widget that renders an image sequence animation. It supports looping animations by default, as well as manual progress control through functions like forward, reverse, and stop.
use_when: You need to play an image sequence or sprite-like animation using a series of indexed image files.
You need manual control over an image animation sequence using forward, reverse, and stop methods.
avoid_when: You need complex vector animations or vector formats like Lottie or Rive.
You are loading single images without sequence animation needs.
strengths: Simple API for handling image sequence animations.
Supports both automatic repeating and manual animation control (forward, reverse, stop, animateToTarget).
weaknesses: Very basic feature set with no documented web/desktop optimizations or advanced tweening features.
Limited documentation beyond the basic README.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose lottie if you want scalable vector animations instead of sequential raster images.

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose rive for interactive, high-performance vector animations.
